snippet.title: Emono Official Release Trailer
snippet.description:
In Emono you play as Yuri, a 16-year-old teenage girl, living in an  industrial city in Japan, 1986. On your way home from school, you go to a store near you to buy groceries for dinner, but you are being followed. 

Download Emono for free: 
https://lolscrubs.itch.io/emono
